create_parallel_tiled_vae: create a ParallelTiledVAE instance from a VAEConfig to encode and decode video tensors with tiled memory-efficient processing
encode_video_tensor: encode a video tensor into a DiagonalGaussianDistribution latent using tiled or parallel tiled encoding based on tensor dimensions
decode_latent_tensor: decode a latent tensor back to video frames using tiled, parallel tiled, or standard decoding based on configuration
enable_tiled_vae: enable tiled VAE decoding with configurable tile sizes, strides, and blending parameters for memory-efficient processing
sample_gaussian_distribution: sample from a DiagonalGaussianDistribution to generate latent tensors with optional deterministic mode
